title: TSB stand
features:
Stand for TSB
📌 Main
summon — summon the stand
vanish — vanish the stand
clean — clean the stand (if bugged)
leave — make the stand leave the game
stop — stop all functions
left — move left / side movement
right — move right / side movement
back — move backward
under — move underneath a owner


🔹 Misc
transfer [target] — transfer the stand to a new owner
revert — revert ownership to the original owner (only original owner can use)
emote [emote] — currently broken
fly [animation] — fly1 / fly2 / fly3 / float1 / float2 / float3 / lev1 / lev2 / lev3
frame [target] — frame a target
lift [target] — lift someone into the air slowly
unview — stop viewing a target
view [target] — view someone with the camera
say [sentence] — make the stand say a sentence
rejoin | rj — rejoin the server
reset | re — reset the character
dog [target] -- make the stand become a dog for a target or urself
fguard -- fling aura
jumpscare | js — jumpscare a user this is for first person and vr players

💥 Flings
fling [target] — fling a target
sfling | stopfling | sf — stop flinging
punch [target] — 1-time fling
slam [target] — slam a target
roof [target] — fling (roof fling)

😳 Sussy Cmds
benx [target] -- freaky benx
blow [target] -- freaky blow
doggy [target] -- freaky doggy

🔥  Unanchored Parts (works kinda not always)
these make the stand laggy
tpua | tpunanchored [target] — teleport parts to target (5 seconds)
crush [target] — crush a target with parts
scrush — stop crush
stopcrush — stop the crush effect
